note: Read 2026-10-31 in the uniform texts (teksty jednolite) of the Dziennik Ustaw, through the Sejm's ELI API (api.sejm.gov.pl); the ISAP site itself answered with an Incapsula refusal. Majority: Kodeks cywilny (uniform text Dz.U. 2026 poz. 795), art. 10 § 1: of full age is who has turned eighteen; § 2: a minor gains majority by marriage (not held); art. 11: full capacity with majority. Work: Kodeks pracy (uniform text Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1245), art. 190: a juvenile (młodociany) is fifteen to seventeen, and employing anyone under fifteen is barred (save the § 2[1]-2[3] cases of art. 191, primary-school leavers under fifteen in the year they turn fifteen, not held); art. 191: a juvenile may be employed only after eight-year primary school and with a medical certificate, and one without vocational qualifications only for vocational preparation (light work, art. 200[1], not held). So the form's 15 is employment on the juvenile's terms, not free employment, which starts at eighteen. Performers: art. 304[5] § 1: a child under sixteen may do paid work only for a body in cultural, artistic, sporting or advertising activity, with the prior consent of the legal representative and the permission (zezwolenie) of the competent labour inspector, who refuses it where life, health, development or schooling are endangered (§ 3). No lowest age. Service: Ustawa o obronie Ojczyzny (uniform text Dz.U. 2025 poz. 825), art. 5: Polish citizens are liable to military service from eighteen to the end of the year they turn sixty; art. 152(2): compulsory basic military service (obowiązkowa zasadnicza służba wojskowa) is imposed only by a presidential regulation on the Council of Ministers' motion; art. 153: it lasts nine months. No such regulation was found, and service is voluntary (dobrowolna zasadnicza służba wojskowa), so 'none'. What remains: art. 59: men must report for military qualification (kwalifikacja wojskowa) in the year they turn nineteen; art. 60: women with qualifications useful to the army may be called to it; the form doesn't hold either.
